summary: Verified alignment fix in Planilla semanal totals row. Login as admin, navigated to Control de asistencia > Planilla semanal, moved 4 weeks forward. Measured getBoundingClientRect() of asis-total-bcv vs asis-bcv-<id> and asis-total-bolivares vs asis-bolivares-<id>: both deltas are exactly 0.0px (left and right). Table structure confirmed via DOM inspection: 12 header cells, 12 columns per data row (3 obreros x 12 = tdCount 12 each), totals row has 3 <td> whose colSpan sums to 12 (10 + 1 + 1). Visually the 'Totales de la semana ->' text ends flush with 'Salario diario $' column and Total BCV / Total Bolivares sit under BCV $ and Bolivares columns respectively. No column is empty. Fix confirmed.
action_items: Optional cleanup: none needed. No ZZTEST_ obreros were created (not required to prove the colSpan/alignment fix; math logic path was unchanged). Real data (oswald/ana/superman) and current-week config were NOT touched — only navigated 4 weeks forward to future empty week and set salary=10 (tasa input did not accept 40 in one attempt but this is unrelated to the alignment fix).
critical_code_review_comments: ControlAsistencia.jsx PlanillaSemanal totals row uses colSpan={dias.length + 3} = 10 which correctly spans Obrero + 7 days + Jornales + Salario diario, leaving the two remaining <td> (Total BCV, Total Bolivares) to line up exactly with the BCV $ and Bolivares columns. 12-column table integrity preserved.
